correctness.rationale: For each fixed cyclic starting phase, adding full period L translates counts of symbols and adjacent digrams by a constant independent of the phase, so p2(n+L)=p2(n). A length r<=L factor crosses at most two run transitions. Monochrome classes yield [r<=a]+[r<=b]; one-transition orientations with x in [max(1,r-b),min(a,r-1)] each yield T(r) distinct classes; two-transition factors yield exactly one class per middle-run orientation when r>=b+2 or r>=a+2. Letter/digram counts determine first and last letters, proving disjointness. Summing yields boxed profile; max L cap vs 2min(a,b)+2 and gap-two phase threshold follow. Independently reproduced 7875 signatures for a,b<=15 across lengths 1..2L+3, matching peak and threshold. Finite checks are not proof of arbitrary parameters.
